facts.fact: The vendor's base-case example assumes a $600 monthly ad budget (an assumption, not a market benchmark).
The vendor's example assumes a member pays $120 a month and stays 6 months, giving a lifetime value of $720 (assumption).
facts.quote: a member paying $120 a month who stays 6 months (lifetime value $720)

facts.fact: The vendor's example assumes 40% of intro students join as members (assumption).
In the vendor's scenario C, which assumes a weak landing page, the same media spend returns 60% fewer members than the base case (vendor's illustrative example).
facts.quote: Scenario C costs the same media money as A and returns 60% fewer members.

facts.fact: The vendor recommends running a new Google Ads campaign for at least 60 days before judging it.
The vendor recommends funding a first Google Ads test for at least two months.
facts.quote: Fund it for at least two months

facts.fact: The vendor states it replies to free audit requests with a short action plan within 48 hours.
facts.quote: I reply with a short action plan within 48 hours.

facts.fact: Google's default, recommended location targeting setting is "Presence or interest," which also reaches people who have shown interest in the target area.
facts.quote: Google's default, recommended setting ("Presence or interest") reaches people likely to be in, or regularly in, your target area
